shortDescription: Michael Wilson is Barbara Broccoli's half-brother. "James Bond Outdueled Goldfinger and Dr. No. Can He Win a Battle With Amazon?" at 9 p.m. ET on Dec. 19, 2024, incorrectly said he was her stepbrother.
